Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how Nexora Global handles information through nexoraglobal.agency. It describes our current website and inquiry workflow; it is not a claim that every privacy law applies to Nexora Global or that legal compliance has been established.

Information you provide

When you submit a solar inquiry, we collect the information shown in the form. This may include your name, phone number, email address, property address and ZIP code, property type, relationship to the property, county on a campaign-specific form, electricity bill range, sunlight information, project timeline, financing interest, optional notes, and your consent record.

If you use the solar estimator, the website processes the ZIP code and electricity-use inputs needed to produce the estimate. Estimator results are educational planning information and are not a quote, engineering design, or guarantee.

Information collected automatically

Our website and service providers may receive technical information such as the page requested, referring page, campaign or advertising tags, browser and device information, IP address, timestamps, and basic interaction or diagnostic data. We also use a hidden form field and limited server-side request controls to help detect automated abuse.

How we use information

We use information to receive, review, and verify solar inquiries; respond to you; assess whether an independent solar provider may serve the property; make an authorized referral when appropriate; operate and secure the website; maintain inquiry and consent records; troubleshoot errors; measure website and campaign performance; and handle privacy or communication requests.

Independent solar providers

When appropriate and consistent with the permission shown immediately before submission, Nexora Global may share an inquiry with one participating independent solar provider serving the area. That provider is an independent business, not merely a website service provider, and may use the inquiry to contact you about possible solar options. Provider availability is not guaranteed, and submitting an inquiry does not obligate you to purchase solar.

Website and operational service providers

We use third parties to operate the website and workflow. These categories include hosting and content delivery, Firebase database and application services, Google Analytics when measurement is allowed, live-chat support through Tawk.to, public data or modeling services used by the estimator, security and error diagnostics, and communications or workflow services when configured. Those providers may process information for the limited operational purposes for which we use them, subject to their own terms and privacy practices.

Analytics, advertising measurement, and similar technologies

Google Analytics is used to understand page visits and a small number of website events. Inquiry form answers are not included in the successful-inquiry analytics event. Analytics providers may use cookies, local storage, IP-derived information, or similar technologies as described in their own notices.

The codebase can enable Meta Pixel only when Nexora Global configures a real Pixel ID. When enabled and measurement is allowed, it is designed to send PageView and a parameter-free Lead event only after Firebase confirms that an inquiry was stored. It is not designed to send form answers, contact details, property address, ZIP code, utility information, notes, or the inquiry document ID to Meta. Advanced Matching and Conversions API are not enabled. Meta and the browser may still provide ordinary technical event data associated with a pixel request.

Your privacy and measurement choices

You can use the controls on this page to allow or opt out of Google Analytics and Meta measurement on this browser. We also treat an enabled browser Global Privacy Control signal as an opt-out for those measurement tools. The choice is stored locally in this browser. Clearing browser storage may remove it, and you may need to repeat the choice on another browser or device.

This measurement choice does not disable services you deliberately use, such as submitting an inquiry or opening live chat. You may also use browser settings or content-blocking tools to limit cookies and third-party requests, although some features may then be unavailable.

Contact and communication choices

You may ask Nexora Global to stop contacting you by using the method provided in a message or by contacting support@nexoraglobal.agency. A request sent to Nexora Global may not automatically reach an independent provider, so contact that provider directly as well.

Retention and security

We keep inquiry, consent, and operational records for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described above, recordkeeping, dispute handling, security, and applicable obligations. We have not stated a single fixed public retention period for all records. No internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure.

Privacy requests

You may ask about, correct, or request deletion of information associated with your inquiry by emailing support@nexoraglobal.agency. We may need enough information to verify the request and may retain information where reasonably necessary or required. The availability and scope of particular legal rights depends on the circumstances and applicable law.

Children

This service is intended for adults and is not directed to children under 18. Do not submit a solar inquiry on behalf of a child.

Changes and contact

We may update this policy as the website and its practices change. The updated date will appear at the top of this page. Questions about this policy may be sent to support@nexoraglobal.agency.

Privacy questions and requests: support@nexoraglobal.agency.
